basis: Independent audiovisual model observation, not human listening or production approval

original_result.comparison_reason: First delivers a fully realized vertical cinematic presentation tailored to mobile viewing. It stages the trailer interior, robot arm, sensor mast, and dual-surface gripper mechanism with dynamic perspective, proper scale, and convincing material depth. In contrast, Second isolates a flat isometric graphic in the middle of the frame, leaving over half of the 9:16 screen as vacant negative space and rendering the mechanical contact points small and difficult to parse at phone scale.
original_result.audio_observed: Both cuts share clean, identical voiceover narration, accurate audio sync, and aligned caption timing with no audible distortion or time-stretching.
original_result.source_limits: Contoro's proprietary mechanism and container unloading workflow are verified from primary technology descriptions; neither cut overclaims customer deployment metrics or unverified automation reliability rates.

first.one_viewing_summary: A close, dimensional 3D animation inside a container trailer showing the two-sided gripper engaging a box and pulling it onto the roller conveyor.
observed_strengths: Excellent vertical frame utilization with readable mechanisms and clear depth cues.
Motivated shot progression: establishes tight carton clearance, introduces the robot base/sensor mast, and clearly details two-surface suction contact and extraction.
Finished textures, bevels, and industrial lighting suit the warehouse robotics context.

defects.observed: The transition to the sensor mast shot features a relatively stark gray background wall before cutting back to the carton stack.

second.one_viewing_summary: A single wide isometric vector diagram of the unloading arm centered with large empty borders on top and bottom.
observed_strengths: Clear mechanical linkage articulation showing simultaneous front and side suction gripping.
Clean vector line work and legible typography.

defects.observed: The entire assembly is framed as a small isometric island in the center third of the vertical frame, leaving massive empty margins above and below.
Static wide camera hold throughout all 14.8 seconds without coverage cutaways or punch-ins to emphasize the critical two-sided contact mechanism.
